page: Microsoft Azure EC8eds_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.
This server includes 472 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance class suitable for memory-intensive workloads without requiring the procurement of excess compute cores. It is designed for workloads such as database management, in-memory caching, and data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity relative to processing units.
